tiger.name: Iron Claw
tiger.line: Hold the line. We do not chase; we wait. Let the river do the killing.

orchid.name: General Orchid
orchid.line: Stand firm, protect the fords, and let our banners fly over the valley!

rhino.name: Iron Horn General
rhino.line: Hold the fords, crush the foe, victory is ours!

kite.name: High Wind Kite
kite.line: Hold the fords, watch the skies! No rider crosses KITE's watch unseen!
